framing.text: You step up to the register with your basket. The clerk looks up.
The clerk holds up your bento, gesturing toward the microwave, and asks something. What do they mean?
The clerk nods toward a stack of plastic bags by the register. This time you have to come up with the word yourself — which one is it?
There's one more thing you want. No pointing, no menu — you just say it, and type it out for the clerk.
The register beeps and the clerk rattles off your total — read the word on the screen before the moment passes.
Change counted, bag in hand, you turn for the door. What does a good clerk call after you as you leave?
The automatic door slides open, and the clerk's thanks follow you out into the street.
